name: Mechanical Vibrations
summary: Free and forced vibration of single- and multi-degree-of-freedom and continuous systems, and how to isolate, absorb and measure vibration.

topics.name: Free vibration of undamped single-degree-of-freedom systems; natural frequency
Damped free vibration: viscous, Coulomb and structural damping; logarithmic decrement
Harmonically forced vibration: resonance, magnification factor and phase
Base excitation, rotating unbalance and transmissibility
Response to general excitation: impulse response, convolution and shock spectra
Two-degree-of-freedom systems and dynamic vibration absorbers
Multi-degree-of-freedom systems: eigenvalue problem, mode shapes and modal analysis
Continuous systems: strings, bars, shafts and beams
Rayleigh's method and other approximate methods
Torsional vibration of shafts and drivetrains
Vibration measurement and experimental modal analysis
